acceptance_criteria: `pub enum TopoKind { Face, Edge, Vertex }` and `pub struct SubShape { pub kind: TopoKind, pub index: usize }`, documented, deriving at least `Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash`.

`Kernel::sub_shape_count(&self, s, kind) -> Result<usize, KernelError>` and `Kernel::adjacent(&self, s, of: SubShape, kind: TopoKind) -> Result<Vec<SubShape>, KernelError>`, documented and implemented for `OcctKernel`. `adjacent` works for every pair of different kinds (up: faces of an edge, edges of a vertex, faces of a vertex; down: edges of a face, vertices of an edge, vertices of a face). Its result is sorted by index and has no duplicates.

Box test: `make_box((0, 0, 0), (10, 20, 30))` has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 vertices. Every face has 4 edges and 4 vertices, every edge has 2 faces and 2 vertices, every vertex has 3 edges and 3 faces. Going up and down agree: edge `e` is in `adjacent(face f, Edge)` exactly when face `f` is in `adjacent(edge e, Face)`, for all pairs.

Plate test: the #90 plate with a hole, a 40 × 25 rectangle from (0, 0) with a circle of radius 5 at (20, 12.5) as a hole on `Workplane::XY`, extruded by `Distance(10)`. It has 7 faces, 15 edges and 10 vertices (the hole has one seam edge; this satisfies the Euler–Poincaré formula V − E + F − R = 2(S − G) with R = 2 inner loops, S = 1, G = 1). Exactly 2 faces have 5 edges (the caps), 4 faces have 4 (the flat sides), and 1 face has 3 (the hole: two circles and the seam). If OCCT reports other counts, explain them in the PR and the QA report rather than changing the test to match silently.
Errors, each with a test and never a panic: an index out of range for its kind, and `of.kind == kind`, both `InvalidInput`.
No new dependencies. `swx-kernel` still has no workspace dependencies. Every new shim function is `noexcept` and catches C++ exceptions; every new `unsafe` block is in `ffi` and documented.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass, and so do the CI `swx-kernel (occt)` job commands.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
